$comment: ER Studio SDK reference overlay.
The generated layer (parsed from the installed dist/index.d.ts) is the
truth about signatures. This file is the truth about MEANING: English
text, constraints the type system cannot express, and grouping.
The SDK's own JSDoc is written in Chinese. Where `summary` is present
below the panel shows it INSTEAD of the original and marks the entry
EN. Where it is absent the original Chinese is shown verbatim and
marked ZH, so nothing is ever hidden or silently mistranslated.
`notes` are hard-won facts - display constraints, ordering rules,
gotchas. Everything currently in `notes` is sourced from the SDK's own
doc comments; anything you learn on real hardware belongs here too.
Adding a key that no longer exists in the SDK is not an error - the
doctor check reports it as orphaned when Even ships a new version.

groups.label: BRIDGE
groups.blurb: The host <-> WebView channel. Everything reaches the glasses through here.

groups.label: CONTAINERS
groups.blurb: Page container models. Build these, hand them to the bridge.

groups.label: EVENTS
groups.blurb: What the OS pushes back: taps, scrolls, IMU, audio.

groups.label: DEVICE
groups.blurb: Glasses and ring identity, connection state, user info.

groups.label: UTILITIES
groups.blurb: Loose-key JSON readers. Internal helpers that happen to be exported.

EvenAppBridge.summary: The singleton channel between your web page and the Even App host. Every glasses operation goes through this object: you never talk to the display directly.
notes: Singleton - use getInstance(), or await waitForEvenAppBridge() which also guarantees readiness.
Calling any method before the bridge is ready throws. Check .ready or await the helper.
The simulator implements this surface over the automation port; real hardware adds BLE latency that the simulator does not reproduce.

getInstance.summary: Returns the singleton, creating it if it does not exist yet.

ready.summary: True once the bridge has finished initialising and is safe to call.

_ready.summary: Backing field for `ready`. Prefer the getter; this is not part of the stable surface.

callEvenApp.summary: Generic escape hatch: invoke a host method by name. The typed wrappers below are built on this.
notes: Use a typed method where one exists - they normalise the response shape. Reach for this only for host methods the SDK has not wrapped yet.

getUserInfo.summary: Reads the signed-in Even account's user info.

getDeviceInfo.summary: Reads glasses/ring device info. Resolves null when no device is paired.

setLocalStorage.summary: Writes a string value to host-side persistent storage, keyed by name.

getLocalStorage.summary: Reads a previously stored string value by key.

getAppLocation.summary: One-shot location read. Resolves null if the host has no fix or the coordinates fail validation.

startAppLocationUpdates.summary: Begins continuous location updates; pair with onAppLocationChanged to receive them.

stopAppLocationUpdates.summary: Stops continuous location updates started by startAppLocationUpdates.

pickImageFromAlbum.summary: Opens the host photo picker and resolves the chosen image, or null if cancelled.

captureImageFromCamera.summary: Opens the host camera and resolves the captured image, or null if cancelled.

createStartUpPageContainer.summary: Creates the app's initial page container on the glasses. Mandatory first render call.
notes: Must be called once when a custom app launches. Every later layout change goes through rebuildPageContainer instead.

rebuildPageContainer.summary: Replaces the current page layout. This is the normal per-frame update path after startup.

updateImageRawData.summary: Pushes raw image bytes into an existing image container without rebuilding the page.

textContainerUpgrade.summary: Updates the contents of an existing text container in place.

audioControl.summary: Opens or closes the microphone stream, optionally selecting glasses or phone as the source.

imuControl.summary: Enables or disables IMU reporting and sets the report rate.

shutDownPageContainer.summary: Tears down the page container and exits. exitMode 0 exits immediately, 1 pops up one level.

onLaunchSource.summary: Fires with how this session was launched - app menu or glasses menu. Returns an unsubscribe function.

onDeviceStatusChanged.summary: Fires on device connection/state changes. Returns an unsubscribe function.

onEvenHubEvent.summary: The main input path: taps, scrolls, system events, IMU and audio all arrive here. Returns an unsubscribe function.

onAppLocationChanged.summary: Fires on location updates while updates are running. Returns an unsubscribe function.

waitForEvenAppBridge.summary: Resolves once the bridge is initialised. The safe way to start any G2 app.
notes: Returns immediately if the bridge is already ready, otherwise waits on the 'evenAppBridgeReady' event, with a 100 ms re-check as a fallback.
Await this before your first render - it is the single most common cause of a blank display on first boot.
waitForEvenAppBridge.example:
const bridge = await waitForEvenAppBridge();
const info = await bridge.getUserInfo();

CreateStartUpPageContainer.summary: The initial layout payload: how many containers the page has, and the text/image/list objects inside it.
notes: containerTotalNum must be 1-12.
At most 8 textObject entries.
At most 4 imageObject entries.
widgetId is normally injected by the bridge - do not set it by hand.
Field model only: no protobuf encoding happens here.

RebuildPageContainer.summary: The layout payload for every update after startup. Same shape and same limits as the create call.
notes: containerTotalNum must be 1-12.
At most 8 textObject entries.
At most 4 imageObject entries.

ShutDownContaniner.summary: Exit payload. Note the SDK's spelling - 'Contaniner' - it is not a typo on your side.
notes: exitMode 0 exits immediately; exitMode 1 pops up one level.

TextContainerProperty.summary: A positioned text region on the glasses display.
notes: Display is 576 x 288, monochrome green - the ER Studio mirror renders it 1:1.
TODO: confirm the coordinate origin and whether width/height clip or wrap. Verify on hardware and record it here.

ImageContainerProperty.summary: A positioned image region. Pair with updateImageRawData to push pixels without a full rebuild.
notes: Images are converted to 4-level grayscale host-side; ImageRawDataUpdateResult reports conversion and size failures separately.

ListContainerProperty.summary: A scrollable list region. Item geometry and selection border come from ListItemContainerProperty.

ListItemContainerProperty.summary: Per-item geometry for a list container: item count, item width, selection border flag, and the item labels.
notes: isItemSelectBorderEn is a 0/1 integer, not a boolean.

validateEvenHubPageContainerZOrder.summary: Checks same-page z-order rules before a payload reaches the native bridge. Run it in dev - a rejected payload on-device gives a much worse error.
notes: Omitting zOrderIndex everywhere is accepted; mixing set and unset values within one page is not.

EvenHubEvent.summary: The unified inbound event. Exactly one of the payload properties is populated - check which is non-null and use it directly.

EvenHubEventType.summary: Discriminator for EvenHubEvent: listEvent, textEvent, sysEvent, audioEvent, notSet.

OsEventTypeList.summary: OS-level event codes: click, scroll top/bottom, double click, foreground enter/exit, abnormal exit.

AudioEventPayload.summary: PCM bytes pushed by the host during a microphone session.
notes: audioPcm arrives as number[] or base64 depending on host serialisation - bytesToJson normalises it.

ImuReportPace.summary: IMU report rate. Encoded on the wire as integers from 100 to 1000.

ImageRawDataUpdateResult.summary: Result of an image push: 0 success, 1 image exception, 2 size invalid, 3 grayscale conversion failed.

StartUpPageCreateResult.summary: Result of the initial container creation, aligned with the host's EhStartUpPageCreateResult.

EvenHubErrorCodeName.summary: Named error codes, matching the protocol enum names exactly.

DeviceInfo.summary: Identity of a paired Even device.
notes: model and sn are immutable after construction; status may be replaced but its sn must match.

DeviceStatus.summary: Live device state - connection, battery and similar runtime values.

notes: Deliberately not BLE-specific in naming, even though BLE is the common transport today.

LaunchSource.summary: How the page was opened: 'appMenu' or 'glassesMenu'. Pushed by the WebView once loading completes.

pick.summary: Returns the first present key's value from an object, in the order given.

pickLoose.summary: Like pick, but falls back to underscore-stripped, case-insensitive matching (containerID / ContainerID / Container_ID).

normalizeLooseKey.summary: Normalises a key for loose matching: strips underscores and lowercases.

toNumber.summary: Best-effort number coercion; returns undefined when impossible. Tolerates numeric strings from the host.

toString.summary: Best-effort string coercion; returns undefined when impossible.

readNumber.summary: Loose-key number read from a host JSON object.

readString.summary: Loose-key string read from a host JSON object.

toObjectRecord.summary: Coerces a value to a plain record, returning {} for non-objects so parsers do not throw.

isObjectRecord.summary: True for plain objects only - arrays, null and undefined are false.

bytesToJson.summary: Normalises byte-like data (string, Uint8Array, ArrayBuffer) into a JSON-safe payload.

JsonRecord.summary: Alias for Record<string, any>. Used throughout the loose-key JSON helpers.

$comment: Where OFFICIAL DOCS goes for a given symbol.
The old default, evenrealities.com/developer, is the marketing site -
it has no API content at all, which is why the button felt broken: it
was a placeholder that every symbol fell through to.
There is no per-symbol API page to link to. Even's own docs say the
*.d.ts files are the authoritative reference and document the API by
TOPIC instead (page lifecycle, display, device APIs). So the mapping
below is topic-based, and the panel labels the link with the page it
actually opens rather than pretending it is a symbol page.
Resolution order, in sdkref.js merge():
members  byMember['Owner.member'] -> byMember['member'] -> owner link
symbols  bySymbol[name] -> byGroup[group] -> default
Anything unmapped resolves to the docs root, never to a dead anchor.
Anchors verified against the live site 2026-08-12.
